payload.body: Reality check: the cutover (code + docs) landed on PR #8 but the v0.4.0 RELEASE in this title was deliberately split out — the user chose code+docs only, no tag/publish. Version bumped to 0.4.0 in files; the actual tag + npm/Swift/Android publish is a separate post-merge step. Post-cutover bugs found + fixed/fixing: FR-257 (object-Delta), FR-258 (CORS+logout), FR-259 (standalone binary/deploy), FR-260 (init). Remaining gaps captured as FR-261..FR-264.
